limitations: DVOL public history begins in April 2021, so 2020 is unavailable.
Hourly decisions can miss intrahour regime changes.
A surviving historical route would still require shadow forward evidence.

protocol.execution_rails: max 2 new trades/rolling hour; one position/symbol; 3h same-direction cooldown; pause after 3 daily losses
